title: Strict-system realization of the integral exceptional operation
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and finite-type schemes $X,Y$ over the global field datum with $\ell\ne p$, together with a separated finite-type morphism $f:X\to Y$. Use the completed coefficient sheaf and strict reduction tower [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower] and the normalized pullback/tensor reduction calculus [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Define the ambient integral exceptional realization as follows. Lift $\mathcal O_E$ to the site-value universe, identify its uniformizer quotients with the original finite coefficient rings by the explicit quotient equivalences, and change coordinates on actual strict systems. Apply the etale/pro-etale derived system comparison [lem-pur-coefficient-system-derived-comparison], the ordinary etale compact-support system right adjoint [lem-pur-etale-coefficient-system-adjoint] at the canonical Nagata compactification, the inverse site comparison, and inverse quotient coordinates. The total derived inverse limit is the integral exceptional realization. Its chosen comparison is characterized by exact-localization representative equations and universal right-derived-unit equations; its open extension and exceptional right adjoint are characterized uniquely by their Hom-transpose equations. On the finite-Tor constructible subcategory [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], this ambient functor is naturally isomorphic, on objects and all morphisms, to the integral operation of every coefficient-compatible System recorded by [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image].
